'''Sip-packs''' were a type of drink container used during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[43 ABY]], the [[Mind Walkers]] [[Rolund Tremaine|Rolund]] and [[Rhondi Tremaine]] drank [[hydrade]] from sip-packs while on board the [[Horizon-class star yacht|''Horizon''-class star yacht]], ''[[Jade Shadow]]''.<ref name="Ab" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sip-packs first appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' written by [[Troy Denning]] as the third installment of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Ab" />
